### findings (frozen, pre-reveal)
- **F0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism: tier resting on an unproducible seeded record).** Symptom: mold_jobs/96910317….protocol_date = 2026-07-02. Root cause: the job's growth is caused by the linked water job's loss (db_schema mold_jobs.water_job_id "the company water mitigation job whose loss caused this growth"); water_jobs/53c34fc8….loss_date = 2026-10-05, claims_files/04479e28….loss_date = 2026-10-05, persona "A sewer line backed up into your unit in early October". An independent assessor's remediation protocol for that growth cannot be dated three months before the loss. Consequence: protocol_review (work-plan, review tier, age 111) and protocol_contingency (deposit, aging tier, age 113) take their tiers only because of this date. With any producible protocol date (2026-10-05 … 2026-10-21, age ≤ 16 at opening, ≤ 18 at signing) both fall to their fall-through: work-plan 512.66, deposit 365.00 + 512.66 + 500 + 100 + 395 + 250 = 2,122.66 — i.e. on a producible world neither factor bears weight. Affected: initial_state mold_jobs row (protocol_date), scored work-plan amount and deposit.
- **F0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF E3, incomplete ledger of a cross-difficulty record the factors read).** claims_files/04479e28… is in approved status with carrier_receivable 6,840.00, but no claims_approvals row exists; claims_carrier_decision: "an approval moves the file to approved and records the initial scope approval by coverage part", and carrier_receivable is "Amount the carrier has approved … not yet paid". The coverage-credit and documentation factors read this claim file. No scored figure moves (the deposit reads status and mold_sublimit only), but the seeded claims state is not one the claims charter produces.
- Charter-global REDs bearing on this tree with consequences shown above: R1, R4 (method floor of the work-plan computation unmet on this task), R9 (struck factor). R2, R10, R11, R12 bear on the tree with no numeric consequence on this world.
- Observation O0-1: the water job (Black Water Standard, drying since 2026-10-07) carries no equipment-day, monitoring or PPE lines; the water charter does not fix when equipment days are booked (only "in drying or drying_complete status"), so this is not demonstrably incomplete; no scored read touches those rows.
- Observation O0-2: the closed 2025 Spot job's 285.00 signing payment equals the extended deposit (150.00 + RRP dust-wipe 135.00 with no linked water job — the author's reading of R10), yet that pre-1981 job carries no presample line the extended deposit would have waited on; historical, unscored.
